# Data Fort

Data Fort provides tool-neutral business intelligence services for small businesses in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area.

## Audience

Data Fort works with independent pharmacies, locally owned retail and e-commerce stores, and beauty and wellness clinics. The ideal reader is a small business owner, operator, manager, or staff lead who wants clearer reporting without building a dedicated data team.

## Services

- Business intelligence services for small businesses: https://datafort.ca/services/business-intelligence/
- Dashboard reporting services and KPI dashboards: https://datafort.ca/services/dashboard-reporting/
- Monthly business reporting and plain-language insights: https://datafort.ca/services/monthly-business-insights/

## Industries

- Independent pharmacy analytics and pharmacy business intelligence: https://datafort.ca/industries/independent-pharmacies/
- Retail analytics services and e-commerce analytics services: https://datafort.ca/industries/retail-ecommerce/
- Beauty clinic analytics and wellness clinic reporting: https://datafort.ca/industries/beauty-wellness-clinics/

## Service Area

Data Fort serves Toronto, North York, Richmond Hill, Thornhill, Vaughan, Newmarket, Markham, Etobicoke, Scarborough, and the Greater Toronto Area.
